## Verdict

missing

## Bearer

Eleven `ViewModel` classes, each the caller that must wrap its own call site:

- `ProfileViewModel` — app-phone/.../ui/profile/ProfileViewModel.kt
- `RaceDetailViewModel` — app-phone/.../ui/racedetail/RaceDetailViewModel.kt
- `ImportPreviewViewModel` — app-phone/.../ui/importpreview/ImportPreviewViewModel.kt
- `PasteResultViewModel` — app-phone/.../ui/pasteresult/PasteResultViewModel.kt
- `ControlViewModel` — app-wear/.../control/ControlViewModel.kt
- `EndOfRaceViewModel` — app-wear/.../endofrace/EndOfRaceViewModel.kt
- `HomeViewModel` — app-wear/.../home/HomeViewModel.kt
- `PreparationViewModel` — app-wear/.../preparation/PreparationViewModel.kt
- `ProjectionViewModel` — app-wear/.../projection/ProjectionViewModel.kt
- `MainRacePageViewModel` — app-wear/.../race/MainRacePageViewModel.kt
- `SensorPermissionViewModel` — app-wear/.../sensor/permission/SensorPermissionViewModel.kt

None of these sites follow from one another — each is an independent call
site in an independent class, so this report names all eleven rather
than picking one.

## Trigger

Each site is reached from a mechanism already in the ViewModel — a
button handler, a property initialiser or `init` — observed in every
case below.

## Today

Sixteen call sites reach a `ProfileRepository`, `RaceRepository`,
`ExerciseSessionManager`, `UndoMarkingController`, `StopRaceController`,
`RaceLaunchController`, `SegmentMarkingController` or
`SensorPermissionManager` method directly, on the calling thread,
outside `viewModelScope.launch` — while the same class runs its other
work inside `viewModelScope.launch`:

- `ProfileViewModel.onHrMaxUpdated`, `.onExpectedDistanceChanged`,
  `.onLongPressChanged`, `.onZoneThresholdChanged` call
  `profileRepository.updateHrMaxBpm` / `.updateExpectedDistanceM` /
  `.updateLongPressMs` / `.updateZoneThreshold` directly.
- `RaceDetailViewModel`'s `lastKnownRace` property initialiser calls
  `raceRepository.findById(raceId)` directly (in the constructor body,
  no coroutine at all — the class scope covers `uiState` only).
  `onSetAsReferenceClicked` calls `raceRepository.setAsReference`,
  `onRenameConfirmed` calls `raceRepository.rename`, and
  `onDeleteConfirmed` calls `raceRepository.delete`, all directly.
- `ImportPreviewViewModel.onSaveClicked` calls
  `raceRepository.saveImportedRace` directly; the class has no
  `viewModelScope` usage anywhere.
- `PasteResultViewModel`'s `today` property initialiser calls
  `clock.now()` directly, in the constructor body.
- `ControlViewModel.onUndoClicked` calls `undoMarkingController.undo`
  directly; `onStopConfirmed` calls `stopRaceController.stop` directly.
  The class has no `viewModelScope` usage anywhere.
- `EndOfRaceViewModel`'s `init` block calls
  `exerciseSessionManager.close()` and, when a retained factor exists,
  `profileRepository.updateCorrectionFactor(...)` directly. The class
  has no `viewModelScope` usage anywhere.
- `HomeViewModel`'s `currentSensorPermissionReminderVisible` property
  initialiser calls `sensorPermissionManager.isGranted()` directly, in
  the constructor body — the rest of the class uses `viewModelScope`.
- `PreparationViewModel.onLaunchClicked`, on the `Ready` branch, calls
  `raceLaunchController.launch(...)` directly (only the `OpenFailed`
  branch, calling `retryAndLaunch`, uses `viewModelScope.launch`).
- `ProjectionViewModel.onPressEnd` calls
  `markingController.onPressEnd(...)` directly; the class has no
  `viewModelScope` usage anywhere.
- `MainRacePageViewModel.onPressEnd` calls
  `markingController.onPressEnd(...)` directly; the class has no
  `viewModelScope` usage anywhere.
- `SensorPermissionViewModel.onResumed` calls
  `sensorPermissionManager.isGranted()` directly (the rest of the class
  uses `viewModelScope`).

None of the called methods are `suspend` — `ProfileRepository`,
`RaceRepository`, `UndoMarkingController`, `StopRaceController`,
`RaceLaunchController.launch` (unlike `.retryAndLaunch`, which is
`suspend`) and `ExerciseSessionManager.close` are plain functions, so
none of these calls needs a coroutine to compile. But the repository
implementations reach Room DAO methods synchronously —
`RaceRepositoryImpl.setAsReference/rename/delete/saveImportedRace` call
`raceDao.findById`/`.update`/`.delete` directly, with no
`Dispatchers.IO` indirection anywhere in `:core-data`. Neither
`app-phone`'s nor `app-wear`'s `RepositoryModule` calls
`allowMainThreadQueries()` or supplies a custom query executor on the
production `Room.databaseBuilder(...)`. A call reached from a button
handler or a property initialiser runs on the caller's thread, which
for a ViewModel constructor or a Compose-driven click handler is the
main thread — Room's default main-thread guard applies there.

## Expected

Every one of the sixteen call sites above runs inside
`viewModelScope.launch` (or, for `RaceDetailViewModel.lastKnownRace`
and `PasteResultViewModel.today`, whatever mechanism replaces a
constructor-time read with one collected after a coroutine has
started), so the repository, controller or manager call it makes is
dispatched off the thread that triggers it, consistently with how each
class already handles its other repository and service calls.
